title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The much anticipated Japanese Derby is here, and the entire audience is focused on the long-awaited showdown between the BNW trio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Prior to the race, Biwa Hayahide senses something peculiar about Winning Ticket, just like with Narita Taishin at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket's dream is to win the Derby. Her focus has been so singular that she's been isolating herself to train for it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide tries to convince herself that she can pin down the source of that strange feeling as she heads out to the race.
